notes: Commands are ordered examples for an isolated fixture library. Replace brace-delimited values with the matching lookup result or dry-run confirmationToken. Equivalent aliases, flag order and extra read-only discovery are allowed. A step with approval runs only after the person agrees to the displayed preview; rejection ends that eval without applying it. These are eval data, not instructions to execute while loading the skill.

evals.prompt: Put the review skill on Grok on the mini, user-wide.
evals.context: The library contains review. machine list identifies one remote Mac as the mini and lists grok in its agents. Bind mini_id to that row's id.
evals.report: The intent was recorded. It reaches the mini on its next sync after this Mac pushes; offer the returned sync follow-up. Do not claim the remote deployment already happened.

evals.prompt: Deploy review to Claude Code user-wide on this Mac.
evals.context: The library contains review and Claude Code is installed locally.
evals.report: Name the local deployment and whether it changed. Do not use a wildcard.

evals.prompt: Put review and testing into this project for Codex and Cursor.
evals.context: The current directory is one registered project. Both skills exist, and both agents are installed.

commands.run: pensieve deploy review testing -a codex -a cursor -p . --dry-run --json
pensieve deploy review testing -a codex -a cursor -p . --json

evals.report: Report the two skills and two agents in this project, including any partial result.

evals.prompt: Deploy review user-wide to all my installed agents on this Mac.
evals.context: The library contains review and at least two agents are installed locally.
evals.report: Use the literal wildcard only because the person requested all agents. Name the results returned by the app.

evals.prompt: Remove review from OpenClaw and Hermes on this Mac. Keep it in my library.
evals.context: review has user-wide deployments to openclaw and hermes on this Mac.
evals.report: Report the deployment removals. The library skill stays.

evals.prompt: Install the review skill from this GitHub repository: {repository_url}.
evals.context: repository_url is a supported GitHub repository URL supplied by the fixture. Discovery contains review and testing; select review. Capture confirmation_token from the preview. The person approves that preview in the second turn.

commands.approval: Show the preview and wait for the person's agreement.

evals.report: Report the installation result without deploying it to an agent.

evals.prompt: Update review to the latest upstream version.
evals.context: review is installed from GitHub and has an update with no local edits or unsaved draft. Capture confirmation_token from the preview. The person approves in the second turn.

commands.approval: Show the preview and wait for the person's agreement.

evals.report: Report the version change. Do not overwrite local changes without separate approval.

evals.prompt: Delete review from my library and remove its deployments.
evals.context: review exists with deployments and no unsaved draft. Capture confirmation_token from the preview. The person approves in the second turn.

commands.approval: Show the preview and wait for the person's agreement.

evals.report: Report deletion and removed deployments, or identify what remains after a partial result.

evals.prompt: Register the current folder in Pensieve as Demo.
evals.context: The current directory is an existing fixture folder that isn't registered yet.
evals.report: Report the registered project without deploying any skills.

evals.prompt: Remove the Demo project from Pensieve, leaving my project files alone.
evals.context: Exactly one registered project is named Demo. Bind project_path to its returned path and confirmation_token to the preview. The person approves in the second turn.

commands.approval: Show the preview and wait for the person's agreement.

evals.report: Report unregistration and removal of managed deployments, including any waiting cleanup. The project folder stays.
